description: MetaRalph Phase 8: Self-Improvement Pipeline - Recursive self-improvement of Ralph and MetaRalph codebases with safety guardrails.

userStories.title: Register Ralph and MetaRalph as self-managed projects
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to treat my own codebases as special self-improvement targets.
acceptanceCriteria: On daemon start, auto-register Ralph and MetaRalph projects with is_self=true
Self projects always enabled regardless of user opt-in
Self projects have special safety constraints
Self-improvement runs on separate isolated branches

userStories.title: Implement self-analyzer
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to analyze my own codebase for improvement opportunities.
acceptanceCriteria: Looks for: performance issues, code duplication, missing tests, documentation gaps
Proposes: new features, optimizations, bug fixes

userStories.title: Implement sandboxed self-execution
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to safely test self-improvements before applying them.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates changes with full test suite
Validates no regression in core functionality

userStories.title: Implement rollback mechanism
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to rollback failed self-improvements automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: createCheckpoint() saves current state before changes
Auto-rollback triggers on: test failure, validation failure, runtime error
Preserves failed attempt logs for analysis
Notifies user of rollback with reason

userStories.title: Implement self-improvement safety guardrails
userStories.description: As a user, I need safety guardrails so MetaRalph can't break itself.
acceptanceCriteria: NEVER modify: core execution loop, safety guardrails, rollback mechanism without approval
ALWAYS run full validation before merge
High-risk changes (>70) require explicit user approval

userStories.title: Implement self-improvement coordinator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need a coordinator to orchestrate the full self-improvement loop.
acceptanceCriteria: run() triggers: analyze -> propose -> approve -> execute -> validate -> merge/rollback
